title: FX Engine Prototype(2008)
subtitle: Java 1.4
text: Before Hydra-Gen, I created a working prototype. This engine had XAML like scripting abilities in that all the data binding, event handling, component layout, animations, and code binding was scripted in XML format. I incorporated 3D, particle, blurring, fractal and clipping effects as additional engine components.
